body:
PXD024809 provides nominal-dose standards in a serially diluted JY HLA-eluate matrix. Its aligned quantities, scored candidates and transition library use distinct identifiers and missingness states; treating aligned quantities alone as detected concentrations loses essential evidence.

Add `write_dilution_observer_package`, `verify_dilution_observer_package` and 15 relations through the existing `EvidenceStore`. The revision pins 17 originals and preserves all literal cells, large IDs, exact form/charge/target library membership, feature links/comparisons, the full standard panel, nominal levels and scoped protocol/material claims. Independent source snapshots and typed recompilation reject altered evidence after manifest rehash. Version **2.0.40**; current head **1b3ad56**.

DIA1/DIA2 have different reported acquisition windows and are not assumed exchangeable replicates. Missing library standards are not negatives. Nominal solution amounts are not certified on-column amounts; the twofold-versus-1:10 conflict and unknown recovery/actual-parameter claims remain explicit. This is a source package, not an admitted calibration recipe or a model of intracellular abundance.

Validation and pending gates:
- Format and lint pass. The six catalog test files plus source fixtures pass 48 checks; the later subprocess-catalog correction plus source fixtures pass 26 checks (overlapping set).
- All hosted Python 3.10–3.14 unit jobs, lint, integration and combined coverage pass in workflow **40183613623**. The docs build in **40183613700** also passes. These are software gates; the required local suite and real-source replay below remain pending. The earlier single stale-catalog CI failure (3,568 other tests passed) is preserved as a byte-restorable compressed job log.
- Full local tests remain pending: two unchanged preflights refused before pytest at 0.25/0.08 GiB free plus speculative memory.
- [Independent original-source audit](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/tree/50a2af40f32cad0f297d71884c9215310f17011d/experiments/2026-10-25_0844_codex_dilution-scoring-lineage) verifies 1,031,853 rows / 29,039,248 cells and exact cross-file lineage.
- [Canonical build/replay preparation](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/tree/d92606a4ec2cde5cd9f9edd255a62108203f6556/experiments/2026-10-25_0959_codex_dilution-canonical) freezes this implementation and a separate literal/rational checker. Its 13 software-boundary tests pass. **No original canonical package or independent canonical replay has run:** build attempt 1 refused at 69.88 MiB versus the unchanged 3 GiB startup floor and launched no child.
- Before readiness: full local suite, canonical materialization and independent source reconciliation, all final hosted gates, review, merge and verified tested PyPI publication. This remains draft.

Refs #845; the later nominal-dose training recipe remains separately gated.
